request_text: Load the 14-bus test case (case14) and disconnect the line between bus 9 and bus 14 (1-based).
answer:
Step 1
Buses use the displayed IEEE ids 1 through 14. Slack bus is bus 1 with fixed voltage 1.06 p.u. and angle 0 deg. PV generator buses are 2, 3, 6, and 8 with specified voltage setpoints. PQ load buses are 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, and buses 2, 3, 6 also have net load in addition to generation.

Step 2
The disconnected branch is the line with from_bus 9 and to_bus 14, which is line table row index 11, so line_id 11 is out of service for this calculation. All other lines remain in service. Transformer branch ids are 100000 through 100004 corresponding to transformer rows 0 through 4.

Step 3
Requested quantities are bus voltage magnitude in p.u. and angle in degrees, branch active power at the from or hv side in MW, and loading in percent. Since thermal ratings are undefined, loading_percent is reported as 0 for every branch. System totals requested are total generation MW, total load MW, and total losses MW.

Step 4
Relative to the base case, only line 9-14 is disconnected. Bus 14 remains connected through line 13-14 only, so the network stays connected. Power balance must hold so total generation equals total load plus total losses. With the outage, flows in the 9-14 and 13-14 corridor redistribute, especially through 7-9, 4-9, and 13-14. Voltage limit check is against below 0.95 or above 1.05 p.u.; line overrun check is always false here because loading is defined as 0 for all branches.
